claims.evidence: Frame logo/text is visible but illegible in the photo; no model confirmation possible.
Witness only observed a front suspension fork; no rear shock/suspension noted despite rear derailleur area being visible.
Witness confirms a front disc brake only; rear brake type not mentioned or visible.
Multiple gear/derailleur setup clearly visible at rear wheel.
No purchase date, receipt, or packaging shown; history cannot be confirmed from a photo.
No functional test or video of shifting/braking; static photo cannot show performance.
Witness report lists rust/wear condition as not clearly shown; no close-up confirms absence of rust.
No way to confirm part authenticity or originality from a single outdoor photo.

risks.risk: Frame may have hidden cracks, dents, or repairs
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, welds, and underside of the top/down tube
risks.if_unproven: priced as frame condition unknown, assume cosmetic/structural flaws possible

risks.risk: Rear suspension may not exist despite 'dual suspension' claim
risks.proof: Side-on photo clearly showing rear shock absorber or rigid rear triangle
risks.if_unproven: priced as a hardtail (single front suspension only)

risks.risk: Rear brake may be rim brake, not disc, despite 'dual disc brake' claim
risks.proof: Close-up photo of rear wheel hub/brake assembly

risks.risk: Tires may be worn or damaged despite appearing knobby
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tread depth and sidewalls on both wheels
Short video clip of gear shifting through all speeds and brake engagement test
risks.if_unproven: priced as functionality unverified, assume minor repairs needed

risks.risk: Rust or corrosion on chain, spokes, or frame joints
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chain, spokes, and frame joints in good lighting
risks.if_unproven: priced as possible surface rust present

risks.risk: Usage history and true age may differ from claimed 6 months
risks.proof: Purchase receipt, warranty card, or original box photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as used bicycle of unknown age

risks.risk: Frame size/wheel diameter mismatch with buyer's needs
risks.proof: Photo with tape measure on frame and wheel, or stated size label
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard/generic size, unconfirmed fit

proof_requests: Clear close-up of frame logo/decal showing brand and model name
Side-on full bike photo showing rear wheel/frame area to confirm presence or absence of rear suspension
Close-up of rear wheel hub/brake to confirm disc vs rim brake
Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls on both wheels
Short video of gear shifting through all gears and brake test (front and rear)
Close-up photos of chain, spokes, and frame joints for rust/wear check
Photo of purchase receipt or original box/warranty card
Photo with a tape measure against frame and wheel for size confirmation
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a mountain bicycle with a front suspension fork and visible gear system, so it can be priced at worst case (single suspension, unverified rear brake type, unverified condition) pending the listed proofs.
